I answered Tobias in a thread on their #central-random message: the ticket number is **PD-4821**.

It comes from #central-team, which Tobias is in. Hollis posted there on 9 Jun 2026 that the Eastbank receiving-door import is attached to PD-4821. The door labels didn't match: the file uses E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. I didn't see any later status update, and I said so in the reply.

It was fine to post in that channel because ticket numbers are operational information, and #central-random has the same members as #central-team.
